name: Suno V6 Mini
description: Suno V6 Mini is the faster, more efficient member of Suno's v6 music-model generation. Suno says it is available to everyone and makes it easier to turn an idea into a song.

details.name: supported_inputs
details.value: Suno describes creation with text, audio, images, and video across the v6 models.

details.name: pricing
details.value: The announcement does not publish an API price or per-generation credit rate.

page_notice.markdown: Suno V6 Mini is a consumer product release available to everyone. Suno has not published an official API model ID or API pricing in this announcement, so no Phaseo API route is asserted.

sources.notes: Official announcement dated September 9, 2026 names v6-mini, describes it as faster and more efficient, and says it is available to everyone.

verification.notes: Official product name, release date, availability, and product modalities verified. API model ID, API route, and API pricing remain unpublished.
